Symbols:
  Q: volumetric filtrate flow rate through the fouled membrane [m^3 s^-1] (computed)
  Q_{open}: volumetric flow rate through the open pores [m^3 s^-1] (computed)
  Q_{blocked}: volumetric flow rate through the blocked pores [m^3 s^-1] (computed)
  \Delta P: transmembrane pressure driving filtration [Pa] (variable)
  \mu: solution viscosity [Pa s] (parameter)
  R_{m}: clean membrane hydraulic resistance [m^-1] (parameter)
  A_{open}: area of membrane that remains uncovered at any given time [m^2] (computed)
  A_{blocked}: area of membrane surface blocked by protein aggregates [m^2] (variable)
  R_{p}: hydraulic resistance of the protein deposit over a particular region of the membrane [m^-1] (computed)
  \alpha: pore blockage parameter equal to membrane area blocked per unit mass of protein convected to the membrane surface [m^2 kg^-1] (computed)
  C_{b}: bulk protein concentration [mass/volume] (variable)
  f: fractional amount of total protein present as aggregates [-] (variable)
  A_{agg}: membrane area blocked by a single aggregate [m^2] (variable)
  M_{agg}: mass of a single aggregate [kg] (variable)
  m_{p}: mass of the protein deposit per unit area [kg m^-2] (computed)
  f^{\prime}: fraction of the proteins that contribute to the growth of the deposit [-] (variable)
  J_{blocked}: filtrate flux through each region of the membrane (computed)
  R^{\prime}: proportionality constant linking hydraulic resistance of the protein deposit to its mass per unit area (variable)

Model-wide assumptions (already recorded, do not repeat):
  - The initial deposit is partially permeable, allowing finite flow through blocked pores.
  - Pore coverage rate is proportional to convective protein‑aggregate flow rate.
  - Deposit hydraulic resistance is directly proportional to mass per unit area.
  - Specific protein layer resistance R' is constant during constant‑pressure filtration.
